task.title: Implement the D1-040 public documents panel in id/web

issue.title: id/web: add the documents list/read panel for session frames (D1-040 remainder)

payload.problem: Merged PR #7678 completes the session-frame/SSH portion of #3762 but explicitly leaves the web documents panel and web contract tests. No later implementation exists in the web client.
evidence: PR #7678 body: server frames and SSH rendering landed; minimal web panel and web contract tests are explicitly out of that PR.
Current web source inventory has no documents_continue client implementation; open/merged PR search found no later panel PR.
The closed source issue #3762 is not being reopened by this task; issue #14923 tracks the missing web-only acceptance.
acceptance: Web client lists documents using ClientFrame::Documents and follows next_after pages.
Selecting a name reads through ClientFrame::Document and shows name, size, and read-only text.
Web contract tests cover pagination, prefix, reads, refusal cases, and join denial.
Existing SSH and server session behavior remains unchanged; no write/publish path is added.
cd pkgs/id/web && bun run test passes through the required CI/Fleet venue and the existing suite registration covers added tests.

exclude: Server session frames and SSH rendering already delivered by PR #7678

tests: cd pkgs/id/web && bun run test; oracle is the declared web frame contract and the list/read/refusal behavior in the acceptance criteria.
payload.priority_reason: Small, isolated web UI remainder of a closed D1-040 issue; explicitly omitted by PR #7678 and not yet implemented.

dedupe.basis: No later merged PR or live queue task for the documents web panel was found; #3762 is closed and #14923 tracks only its web remainder.
